jobs.description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a Commercial Finance Manager Customer Contracts on behalf of one of our partner companies. You see finance as both a decision and control function, combining accuracy with the curiosity to turn numbers into action.
The partner is strengthening its capability in commercial finance leadership for complex customer contracts and bids. You will connect pricing, contract economics and risk while ensuring that forecasting and negotiation support receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
Finance values dependable reporting, strong controls and constructive partnership. Success means better decisions and trusted information.
How you will work
You will work with finance colleagues, operational leaders and system owners. The partner values early escalation, transparent assumptions and lasting improvements.
This role calls for hands-on leadership and reliable follow-through. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for commercial finance leadership for complex customer contracts and bids.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for pricing and contract economics.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around risk.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting forecasting.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve negotiation support.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through performance.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering commercial finance leadership for complex customer contracts and bids in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of pricing and contract economics.
Practical experience applying risk and forecasting.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving negotiation support.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from B2B services technology and project businesses.
Exposure to performance in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
Your background may be group finance, operations, audit, advisory or a growing business. Show the controls and decisions you owned and the outcome. Direct experience of commercial finance leadership for complex customer contracts and bids is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The role combines professional depth with meaningful business questions and room to improve the processes behind the numbers. The focus on commercial finance leadership for complex customer contracts and bids gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant financial process, decision or transformation you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.
